courtlistener._note: Free Law Project ships an MCP server for CourtListener. Verify the endpoint and auth header against their current docs at install time; the plugin degrades to plugins/lex/scripts/fetch_authority.py if the server is unreachable.

govinfo._note: UNVERIFIED endpoint. If no govinfo MCP server exists in your environment, delete this block; authority_search falls back to web_search + web_extract over govinfo.gov and the plugin marks the source accordingly.

ecfr._note: UNVERIFIED endpoint. eCFR publishes a documented public REST API with no key; plugins/lex/scripts/fetch_authority.py --ecfr uses it directly and is the supported path.
